C0530.title: Shandong Man Sentenced for Repeatedly Insulting and Threatening Cousin Over Wife Harassment
C0530.summary: A man from Cao County, Shandong, named Xu Mouchuang, discovered his cousin Xu Mouzhan had an inappropriate relationship with his wife. Starting in 2019, he repeatedly insulted the cousin in WeChat groups, shouted abuse outside his home, made incessant harassing phone calls and text threats, and even threw bricks and bottles at the house.
